306	## Gotchas
307	
308	- **Social cards (OG previews) are opt-in — off by default.** Pass `--social`
309	  to `init-docs-site.sh` to enable them; a plain scaffold has no social plugin,
310	  no `[imaging]` dep, and no Cairo/Pango CI step, so it builds with zero system
311	  dependencies (a bare `mkdocs build` renders in well under a second). Enable
312	  it when the user wants rich link unfurls and accepts the cost below. To turn
313	  it on for an already-scaffolded site, add the `social` plugin block to
314	  `mkdocs.yml`, `mkdocs-material[imaging]` to the docs deps, the Cairo/Pango +
315	  cache steps to `docs.yml`, and `/.cache/` to `.gitignore` (copy from
316	  `assets/social/*` — the same snippets `--social` injects).
317	- **The `social` plugin needs system Cairo/Pango + the `[imaging]` extra.**
318	  `mkdocs-material[imaging]` pulls cairosvg/pillow, but those bind to system
319	  `libcairo`/`libpango` — without them the build aborts with a libcairo load
320	  error. With `--social`, `docs-workflow.yml.template` apt-installs them
321	  (`libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libfreetype6-dev …`) and caches
322	  `.cache/plugin/social`. Locally: `brew install cairo pango` (macOS) or the
323	  same apt packages (Linux). `--social` also adds `/.cache/` to `.gitignore` —
324	  the plugin writes ~1 card PNG per page (tens of MB) plus a downloaded font
325	  there. Cold build renders one card per page (network-fetches the font from
326	  Google Fonts); warm cache is seconds.
327	- **CJK/arrow page titles render as tofu boxes (□□□) on social cards unless
328	  the card font covers them.** The plugin's default font (Roboto) and plain
329	  "Noto Sans" are Latin-only, so Chinese/Japanese/Korean titles — and even a
330	  `→` in an English title — come out as boxes. `add-language.sh` auto-sets a
331	  CJK-capable `social.cards_layout_options.font_family` (Noto Sans TC/SC/JP/KR)
332	  when you add a CJK language, but only if the social plugin is present and no
333	  font is already set (so scaffold with `--social` *before* adding zh-TW, or
334	  set the font yourself afterward). Verify by opening a rendered
335	  `site/assets/images/social/**/<page>.png`, not just by trusting the build.
336	- **`yq` in these scripts is mikefarah yq (v4), which has NO `if/then/else/end`
337	  syntax** — that's jq. Use `(.plugins[] | select(has("x")) | .x.y) = z` or
338	  `+= […]`, never `.plugins |= map(if has("x") then … else . end)` (it dies
339	  with a `lexer: invalid input text "if …"` error). This bit the i18n
340	  second-language append path historically; keep new expressions in the

342	- **MkDocs strict mode rejects relative `.md` links pointing outside
